title: [GAP-5] Member exit flows are missing (leave Space, leave channel or DM, delete account)
description: Review finding GAP-5: Member exit flows are missing (leave Space, leave channel or DM, delete account) (lens GAP). Location: spec/07-compliance.md:231; spec/02-identity.md:426; spec/04-access-control.md:20, 88-96; spec/14-jmap.md:61. Fix: As proposed. Self-Remove is mentioned only at 07:231 and 02:426, and neither text says who commits it. The spec has no Space-leave operation and no account deactivation ("deactivat" hits only 02:254, which is about the org's revocation authority). The missing member list is the same missing field as in GAP-4, so fix them together. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
